content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 15-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Bhubaneswar recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the application form via email for the Guest Faculty and Guest Counsellor positions at AIIMS Bhubaneswar is 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available for the Guest Faculty and Guest Counsellor positions at AIIMS Bhubaneswar across various disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is via email. Candidates must send their scanned application and documents to the official email address provided by the institute.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the Guest Faculty and Guest Counsellor recruitment at AIIMS Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all candidates applying for the Guest Faculty and Guest Counsellor positions is 64 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be paid Rs. 1000/- per class/hour for Guest Faculty and Rs. 1000/- per session/hour for Guest Counsellors.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for Guest Counsellor?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate Degree in Psychology with 1 year of clinical experience or a Postgraduate Degree in Clinical Psychology, along with mandatory RCI registration.

faq.question: Q8. Is teaching experience mandatory for Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates applying for Guest Faculty positions in English, Computer Science, Bio-medical Sciences, and Odia must have a minimum of 3 years of teaching experience.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for the advertised posts involves a screening or written test followed by a personal interview of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the hard copy of the application be sent?
faq.answer: Hard copies must be sent to The Registrar, Academic Section, AIIMS Bhubaneswar, Post-Dumuduma, Bhubaneswar - 751019, Odisha, in addition to the email submission.
